historical_record.description: A tiled building put up for the A. Friscia Seafoods processing and wholesale business, to the design of Paul F. DeMartini.
Recorded in the city's 1982 survey of North Beach, adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 1999, as an individually listed resource.
Identified by the 2019 updated North Beach survey as appearing eligible for local landmark or California Register / National Register status — recorded as A. Friscia Seafoods.

A survey of 105 properties around North Beach Place, made for the housing project that replaced it, found this building not individually eligible for the National Register but a contributor to a potential historic district.

unknowns: The city's survey's architect appendix dates this building to 1923 while its figure caption and property-type chapter give 1928.
The North Beach context statement dates the A. Friscia Seafoods building here to 1928; the citywide professionals biographies date the same building, to the same builder, 1923.
